ddl.value:
("status" = 'draft' and "posted_at" is null) or
      ("status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "posted_at" is not null)
ddl.name: journal_entries_posted_at_check

ddl.value:
("status" = 'draft' and "confirmed_at" is null) or
      ("status" = 'confirmed' and "confirmed_at" is not null) or
      ("status" = 'cancelled')
ddl.name: orders_confirmation_state_check

ddl.value:
("status" = 'draft' and "confirmed_at" is null and "completed_at" is null) or
      ("status" = 'confirmed' and "confirmed_at" is not null and "completed_at" is null) or
      ("status" = 'completed' and "confirmed_at" is not null and "completed_at" is not null)
ddl.name: stock_transfers_state_dates_check
